ns2:course.label: Dance Activities
ns2:course.description: Skills and knowledge essential for leisure-time activities which are classified as dance activities. Prerequisites and descriptions for each developmental activity may be provided in the Class Schedule. More than one activity may be taken in the same term, but they must be different activities. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to University Residence Halls students.
